customer_review_summary: Customers love the dress's appearance, saying it looks cute in pictures, with one customer noting it resembles a little house on the prairie. However, the fit receives negative feedback, with multiple customers finding it awful.

top_reviews.title: Gingham dreamin 🍒
top_reviews.body: Love this dress. It’s nice quality cotton material. I feel design would best suit those with smaller chests though. I had to keep adjusting the bodice down to fit over my bra which isn’t ideal. The off the shoulder option balances the maxi length and the bows really add a bit of charm and elevation. I felt pretty for Easter 🎀

top_reviews.title: Bows sewn on crooked and not functional
top_reviews.body: Cute dress but the bows are not functional to where you can re-tie them and the were sewn on sideways instead of right side up. I ended up just removing them from the dress entirely. Other than that, dress worked out fine for family pictures

top_reviews.title: False advertisement
top_reviews.body: This dress was such a disappointment. It looks so cute in the picture, but the fabric feels extremely cheap for both the dress and the bows. The fit was awful. Looks nothing like the dress in the picture and and it was really uncomfortable. I returned it right away.

top_reviews.title: God awful crushed velvet bows
top_reviews.body: Hated the bows, but I loved the dress. Crushed velvet does not belong on this. Either put the bows as the same material or don’t put bows at all.

top_reviews.title: Trust the reviews, you get what you pay for
top_reviews.body: It looks okay in photos but in person it looks so cheap. The sleeves are a little too short, and I’m not very tall so I definitely wouldn’t recommend this for anyone over 5 foot 6. The polyester material is thin and wrinkles easily and just looks wrong. Stitching around the elastic is poorly done and the waist area is not flattering.

top_reviews.title: Quality
top_reviews.body: Love this dress so much!! Perfect length and it photographed so beautiful! I wore this for family photos and it was perfect! Only thing is the bows need to be ironed but that’s the only issue!!

top_reviews.title: Off center sewing
top_reviews.body: All the bows are sewn off center and the collar is loose. I need to add a drawstring to the collar and move all the bows. Wouldn’t recommend.
